messages:
Alex Gomez: Heads up — small org/ownership change that starts next Monday. We're consolidating the Capacity and Runtime hiring & operations funnels into a single team named "Capacity & Runtime" under Platform. Jia Li will serve as interim Director while we run a search for a permanent hire. This covers capacity planning, runtime infra, Dedicated/Private deployment hiring lanes, and day-to-day hiring prioritization.

Link to the hiring tracker and role queue (internal): https://redwood.in/ops/hiring-plan — please review and add comments. @Samir Patel: please prioritize senior infra PM + 2 SRE backfills. We'll aim for a 6-week transition window. Ping me with blockers. — Alex

Priya Natarajan: Congrats Jia! Quick question — does this change reporting for observability/console workstreams?

Jia Li: Thanks! Observability remains partnered with Eng Observability for dashboards/traces, but the capacity and runtime hiring and day-to-day resourcing will report to me. I'll publish a 1-pager with RACI and handoff steps by EOD tomorrow.

Samir Patel: On it. I've updated the pipeline and nudged active candidates. Need final hiring owners for the job descriptions — @Jia and @Diego can you confirm who owns runtime eng vs capacity PM?

Diego Morales: Congrats all. Timeline sounds fine. One ask: please call out overlap windows for on-call and critical SLAs during the transition so we don't create blind spots.

Mariam Okoye: Quick note from Private Deployments: please ensure KMS/HSM and compliance POCs are included in the transition docs — we need direct contacts for contract & onboarding flows.

Jia Li: Good catch Mariam — private deployments are in scope. I'll add a section listing KMS/HSM owners, SOC/compliance contacts, and required checklist items. Sync scheduled next Tue 10am to run through handoffs.

HiringBot: Event created — "Capacity & Runtime reorg sync" Tue 10:00. Attendees: Alex Gomez, Jia Li, Mariam Okoye, Diego Morales, Samir Patel.

Alex Gomez: Thanks everyone. We'll aim to keep hiring unaffected and surface any risks in the weekly leadership sync. :tada:

Samir Patel: I'll update candidate briefs and post JD owners here when confirmed.

Jia Li: Adding hiring owners for clarity: Diego — runtime engineers; Priya — capacity PM role; Alex — exec sponsor on interviews. I'll share the draft JD links by EOD.

Priya Natarajan: Sounds good. Happy to help with interview loop design.

Diego Morales: 👍 I'll block time to review JDs.

Mariam Okoye: I'll join Tue sync and bring the compliance checklist.

Alex Gomez: Appreciate it all. If anyone needs additional headcount approvals fast-track, ping me directly.
